extracted.intended_audience: researchers and authors preparing submissions to personality and social psychology journals
extracted.subtask_description: Information for authors about the Journal of Personality and Social Psychology: its topical scope, section-specific focus areas, accepted article types, manuscript style, and where to find submission guidelines. Useful for preparing manuscripts targeted to JPSP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topical coverage and emphasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology publishes papers in all areas of personality and social psychology and emphasizes empirical reports, but may include specialized theoretical, methodological, and review papers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should focus on empirical reports in personality and social psychology; specialized theoretical, methodological, or review manuscripts may be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section: Attitudes and Social Cognition
rubrics_metrics.description: Attitudes and Social Cognition addresses those domains of social behavior in which cognition plays a major role, including the interface of cognition with overt behavior, affect, and motivation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts for this section should center on cognitive aspects of social behavior and examine links between cognition and behavior/affect/motivation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section: Interpersonal Relations and Group Processes
rubrics_metrics.description: Interpersonal Relations and Group Processes focuses on psychological and structural features of interaction in dyads and groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should investigate interpersonal and group interaction processes, including structural and psychological determinants of those interactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section: Personality Processes and Individual Differences
rubrics_metrics.description: Personality Processes and Individual Differences encourages research on all aspects of personality psychology, including individual differences in behavior, affect, health, coping, and motivation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research on personality processes and individual differences (behavioral, affective, health-related, coping, motivational) is appropriate for this section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Articles accepted / emphasis on empirical reports
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal emphasizes empirical reports but may include specialized theoretical, methodological, and review papers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Priority is given to empirical work; theoretical, methodological, or review submissions are considered but should be specialized and clearly relevant to the journal's scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscript style guide
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts should follow APA style and the journal's specific author instructions (see the provided guidelines link for full formatting and submission requirements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Publisher and submission guidelines link
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors must consult the publisher's journal page and the linked author guidelines for detailed submission procedures, formatting requirements, and section-specific instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer review status
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal is peer reviewed; submitted manuscripts will undergo peer review according to journal editorial processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication frequency
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal publishes on a monthly schedule; authors should consider timeline implications when submitting.
